title: Pom
description: Pom is a dish from Suriname featuring chicken thigh, yellow onion, garlic, tomato. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used. Taro is not the same as Surinamese pomtajer; this is a pom-inspired casserole.

steps.instruction: Chop the vegetables as needed. Sauté the listed ingredients over medium heat, stirring, for about 12 minutes until softened and aromatic.
Combine the remaining ingredients, cover partly and stew gently for about 25 minutes until the flavors meld and everything is tender.
Peel and coarsely grate the listed vegetables; squeeze out excess moisture so the mixture will hold together.
Layer the previously prepared components evenly inside a baking dish, serving mold or plate appropriate to the recipe; smooth the surface and avoid mixing the layers.
Bake the grated taro-based casserole until piping hot and fully cooked; raw or undercooked taro can irritate the mouth and throat.
